title: eat shit & die 215
author: bpatrick
body:
I wanted to be sure to get some more Onan in before the end of the summer.

I’ve really been touched by all the support I’ve received through the fun club, thank you! I’m going to do my best to make sure the fun packs are awesome. It’s not too late join if you haven’t already!

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.text:
The first package goes out at the end of the month, but it’s never too late, David. Your year starts from whenever you donate.
Thanks. They were the only sound in the comic so I thought I’d play them up, cbobgo.

comments.author: cbobgo
comments.text: Any chance you could make a separate category on the right side for Onan? That would make it easier to go back and read them all again.
